paragraphs.text: Azgol is a plane only known from Planechase 2012 and March of the Machine . It is a dark, volcanic plane filled with ashen Zombies .

The plane card Lair of the Ashen Idol , and the cards Invasion of Azgol , and Ashen Reaper all depict a dark, fiery world, with a volcano spewing ashes. The volcano, or a creature within, is worshipped by the locals. Creatures are being sacrificed and turned into zombies . No one can approach the Ashen Idol without an offering.
Azgol was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion .
